info.title: AuraVMS API
info.description: Create RFQs, manage suppliers, compare supplier quotations, and place purchase orders. Mutating operations can send supplier email or create business records; obtain user confirmation before calling them.
info.x-versioning-policy: Stable versions are encoded in URL paths. Deprecated operations identify a replacement and advertise Deprecation and Sunset response headers before removal. See https://www.auravms.com/api-versioning.md.
